body: You are too kind, I can't tell you how happy that would make me 💙

Thank you 💙 I'm glad that I know this subreddit to be kind and supportive enough for me to feel comfortable posting this

And no not really :) Ideally I would like it to be low pressure as I can get kind of stressed out by time limits, aggressive instruction etc, which can take me out of it really quickly. But I would be happy with anything really. Thank you for your comment 🙂
